note: 'I want the bar chart to be called "Feature Importance", and keep the gap even' writes the coordination as joining the imperative 'keep' with the nonfinite 'to be called', which stands inside the 'to' relation; 'and' joins 'keep' with 'want'.

'go for marker interval back to one on the order scatter' holds 'back' as a dependent of 'interval', so 'back' becomes part of the description of the interval instead of saying that it goes back to one.
'how about marker interval back to one?' holds 'back' as a dependent of 'interval', so 'back' becomes part of the description of the interval instead of saying that it goes back to one.
'go for plot area wide on the budget pie' holds 'wide' as a dependent of 'area', so the word that says how the plot area should be becomes part of the description of the area instead.
'how about plot area wide?' holds 'wide' as a dependent of 'area', so the word that says how the plot area should be describes the area instead.

'do the vertical dashed lines at every y tick on the revenue trend' makes 'tick' the head of the nominal that holds 'the vertical dashed lines', so two nominals are merged and 'every y' is left as one of its own.

'then do the contour fill the same way on the sales heatmap' is a command, but it is written as an 'interrogative' clause with 'do' as an auxiliary, 'fill' as the verb and 'the contour' as its subject; 'do' is the verb here and 'the contour fill' what it acts on.

'how about marker interval as wide as possible?' holds 'as' and 'wide' as dependents of 'interval', so a linking word and the graded word become part of the description by which the interval is found.

'one more thing: keep the bar edges thicker; also go for error caps grey on the department chart' holds 'grey' as a dependent of 'caps', so the word that says how the caps should be describes them instead.

'and also keep the cap thickness as thick as it gets — while you're at it, go for cap size smaller on the sales chart' holds 'smaller' as a dependent of 'size', so the word that says how the size should be describes it instead, and the relation marked 'on' starts at that nominal.

'I'd like the arrow style curved on the traffic flow chart; also how about arrows large?' writes the declarative 'I'd like the arrow style curved' as an 'interrogative' clause, and folds 'also' and 'how' into it as modifiers.

'hey — I'd like the arrow style curved on the traffic flow chart plus how about arrows large?' writes the declarative 'I'd like the arrow style curved' as an 'interrogative' clause and folds 'how about arrows large?' into it, so that part gets no clause of its own.
'no, put the x axis range back to -3 to 3 from left to right' ties both numbers to the clause with the marker 'to' and writes no tie between them, so the pair '-3 to 3' as one range is not written.
'switch the x axis range back to -3 to 3 from left to right' ties both numbers to the clause with the marker 'to' and writes no tie between them, so the pair '-3 to 3' as one range is not written.

'keep the cap size medium — while you're at it, go for bar edges red on the sales chart' holds 'red' as a dependent of 'edges', so the word that says how the edges should be describes them instead, and the relation marked 'on' starts at that nominal.

'go for cap size medium on the sales chart — while you're at it, have the bar edges red' holds 'medium' as a dependent of 'size', so the word that says how the size should be describes it instead, and the relation marked 'on' starts at that nominal.
'how about cap size medium? and let's have the bar edges red on the sales chart there too' holds 'medium' as a dependent of 'size', so the word that says how the size should be describes it instead.
'I want the colour bar width medium on the sensor contour' holds 'width' as a modifier of the clause, so the words of the nominal 'the colour bar width' are split and 'width' is no longer its head.
'excuse me — Sensor readings by depth: colour bar width medium' holds 'medium' as a dependent of 'width', so the word that says how the width should be describes it instead.
'can you make the colour bar length medium?' holds 'length' as a modifier of the clause, so the nominal 'the colour bar length' is split and 'length' is no longer its head.
